intent.purpose: Catch the newsletters and saved-search alerts worth reading without working through the inbox myself.
intent.success: A two-minute overview of the issues and alerts that match my interests; nothing if nothing qualifies.

interests.focus: Newsletter issues with a concrete AI method, tool or result, not announcements alone.
New listings from my saved flat search that fit its criteria.

newsletters.scope: Messages in the inbox from the newsletter senders listed in setup, received in the last seven days.

alerts.scope: Saved-search alert messages in the inbox from the alert senders listed in setup, received in the last seven days.

procedure.account_identity: Establish the mailbox address from connection metadata; it must equal expected_account before any message is listed.
procedure.read_state: List and preview with operations documented not to change read state. Open a full message only through such an operation; otherwise summarise from the preview and label it as one.
procedure.item_identity: Use the message ID; one message counts as one item, including an alert that lists several results. Messages do not change after receipt.
procedure.pagination: Follow the connector's continuation token until the scope is exhausted or the inspection limit is reached; report which of the two ended the listing.
procedure.retrieval: Use the verified list and read operations for the inbox, restricted to the senders and time window in each target's scope.

selection.include: Newsletter issues with a concrete method, tool or result that matches a listed interest, and alerts with listings that fit the saved search. Give the reason for inclusion.
exclude: Issues that only announce or promote.
selection.uncertain_relevance: Omit weak matches; do not fill the allowance.
selection.evidence: Summarize only inspected content, label truncated previews and distinguish source claims from verified facts.

coverage_threads.on_access_failure: Report the unavailable surface; do not fall back to a browser or another access route.

test: Substantive, clearly outside the listed interests, with a concrete reason to deserve attention.
